samples.title: Interactive Poll System.
samples.hero: A physical voting experience connecting audience input to a live digital counter.
samples.overview: Developed for the Netflix Squid Game 2 promotional activation at MRT Ampang Park, Kuala Lumpur, this Python-based installation invited visitors to vote through physical inputs. Visitors could choose to continue or withdraw, with each selection reflected in an interactive voting counter.
bullets: Developed the Python voting application logic.
Integrated physical voting inputs for the Continue and Withdraw choices.
Implemented counter updates for each voting selection.
steps: 01 / ChooseA visitor selects a voting option through the physical input.
02 / ProcessThe Python application handles the selection.
03 / DisplayThe counter reflects the updated voting result.
